note: Round 2. Whoosh-only pusher options at the game timing (3 normal strokes, 4 Turbo, 1 normal); each scaled to -10 dB against the music (phone band, averaged over the whole file); the current pusher is left as the game plays it at its 50% default. Mixes: the same file over the current music (Classic, Music volume 100%), both rendered from the game code (UAT 54). steepest10msRise: the biggest jump of the loudness envelope in 10 ms, as a share of its peak; a drum, click or thump shows as a big jump.

options.what: the current pusher (a slide plus a beat layer), 50% default
Soft whoosh: one smooth, mid-toned whoosh per stroke; the return is softer and a touch lower
Airy whoosh: lighter and brighter, more "air" than body, a slightly longer tail
Sweeping whoosh: rises as the pusher goes forward ("whooo-sh"), falls on the way back
Quick whoosh: a shorter "fwoosh" at the start of each stroke, so the beat is crisper; return softer
Warm whoosh: rounder and darker (still above phone-speaker bass); the return is only a faint breath
